name: realtime-asset-service
description: Full-stack control plane for ingesting, validating, reviewing, and delivering realtime 3D assets.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @forgeflow/api && npm run build --workspace @forgeflow/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @forgeflow/api" "npm run dev --workspace @forgeflow/web"
